text_block_list.text:
On a day off—while passing through the 
park, I noticed an event titled "Physical 
Enhancement! Ninja Experience Activity" 
taking place.
choice_data_list:
(Maybe this could serve as good reference 
for training...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Shuriken can come in stick shapes 
too?! How do you even throw them...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmm, perhaps you throw them like darts...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you shouldn't hold it by your 
fingertips; instead, rest it in your palm 
along your middle finger—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Without snapping your wrist, throw from 
your elbow—letting it glide off your hand.
choice_data_list: You know a lot about this!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Fufu. When I was little, my 
father loved Japanese culture, so we 
looked into ninjutsu together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! That's amazing! You know so 
much about tea ceremony, and even ninjutsu 
too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then we'll try doing it just 
like Grass-san taught us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I hit it again! Fufu, thanks to your 
advice, Grass-san, I feel like I'm getting 
the hang of it♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmh... I won't lose either! Haaah!

Following Grass Wonder's advice, the two 
of them competed fiercely, dramatically 
improving their accuracy in no time.
choice_data_list:
(Looks like the highest record is 10 in a 
row, though—)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eighth shot—! Ahh, I missed...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I land my eighth shot, it's my win, 
Kita-chan♪ Time to break the record—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even so, improving this much in such a 
short time is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Thinking about not wanting to 
lose to Kita-chan helped me concentrate so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I bet that's why we were able to 
improve, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(...Fufu. When I was little, my sister and 
I used to compete just like this—)

text_block_list.name: Grass's Father
text_block_list.text:
"All right, today we practice bo-shuriken! 
Nin-nin!"

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters
text_block_list.text: "Nin-niin!"

text_block_list.name: Grass's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"I'm way better at this than Big Sister! 
Watch this—taaah!"

text_block_list.name: Young Grass
text_block_list.text:
"It's my turn next—haah! Fufu, right in 
the center♪"

text_block_list.name: Grass's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha! Don't get too carried away 
competing, you two."

text_block_list.name: Grass's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"No way! I wanna get better! Big Sister is 
my rival, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Young Grass
text_block_list.text: "Oh my. It won't be that easy, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(Yes. Back then, we were so absorbed in 
not wanting to lose to each other... ...)

text_block_list.name: Grass's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh! I'll keep getting stronger and 
stronger at this rate, and blow right past 
you, Big Sister!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sorry for taking all the turns. You 
two go next! Maybe you'll set a new 
record!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I wonder~. It was merely something I 
played around with in the past, after 
all~.
choice_data_list:
I'm curious to see your skills, Grass 
Wonder.
I want to see your skills, Grass Wonder.
Should I give it a try?
Maybe I should give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I wonder~. It was merely something I 
played around with in the past, after 
all~.
choice_data_list:
I'm curious to see your skills, Grass 
Wonder.
I want to see your skills, Grass Wonder.
Should I give it a try?
Maybe I should give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really isn't anything special... 
but since the opportunity presents itself, 
shall I take on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a direct hit...!! Amazing, 10 in a 
row! That matches the highest record!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's just an extension of my childhood 
games, but... fufu, you flatter me~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Clearing away the stray thoughts 
allowed me to focus, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing. It's your turn next, Trainer. 
Aim for that new record♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead. Best of luck, Trainer.
(Swish—clatter, roll roll...)
choice_data_list: I-It didn't even reach the target...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It helps to be mindful of your elbow 
movement~. The release speed of your hand 
is crucial as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It was a close attempt though, Trainer! 
Come on, fight on~!

Controlling one's body precisely as 
intended was far harder than it looked... 
Once again, I was reminded of just how 
amazing they were.
